# 3R Core
> Digital marketing agency in Lima, Peru specializing in online stores / e-commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, Tiendanube), SEO positioning and Google Ads, plus web development, branding and social media management. Operating in Peru and the United States.

## About
3R Core is a full-service digital marketing agency based in La Molina, Lima, Peru. The agency combines three generations of experience, strategic vision, and technology to create personalized digital marketing strategies. Founded with the mission to help businesses grow their digital presence across Peru and the United States.

## Key Facts
- Headquarters: Alameda de la Paz 187, first floor, Urb. El Remanso, La Molina, Lima 15024, Peru
- Markets served: Peru, United States
- Languages: Spanish (primary), English
- Areas of expertise: branding, social media, SEO, Google Ads / SEM, web development, e-commerce
- Tech stack offered: Shopify, WooCommerce, custom Next.js, e-learning platforms
- Tax ID (RUC): 20609008211
- Track record: 1,000+ brands worked with, 3 countries, 5+ years (figures confirmed by the company, 2026-08-31)

## Services in Peru (Spanish site, /es)
Prices below are the reference prices each page publishes, in Peruvian soles, net of 18% IGV unless the page says otherwise.
- [SEO positioning](https://3rcore.com/es/posicionamiento-seo): in-house team doing technical SEO, content and links, with the client's own Search Console access; from S/1,800 per month.
- [Google Ads / SEM](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/google-ads): Search, Performance Max and Shopping run inside the client's own Google Ads account; management from S/1,800 per month.
- [Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/meta-ads): campaigns with retargeting, catalog and messages to WhatsApp; management from S/1,500 per month.
- [TikTok Ads](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/tiktok-ads): Spark Ads, native video and in-house UGC creators; management from S/1,500 per month with a monthly report.
- [Performance marketing](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/performance-marketing): Google, Meta and TikTok run together with end-to-end measurement, optimized for CAC and ROAS.
- [AI search positioning (GEO)](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/posicionamiento-ia): work so that ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot cite the client's business; from S/1,800 per month.
- [Web design and development](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/web-development): corporate sites, landing pages and e-commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce) with technical SEO; from S/1,800.
- [Online stores](https://3rcore.com/es/tiendas-virtuales-lima): Shopify, WooCommerce or Tiendanube stores with Yape, Culqi and Izipay and technical SEO; from S/1,500.
- [Branding](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/branding): visual identity, logo, brand manual and applications; from S/500, delivered in 7 days.
- [Social media management](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/socialmedia): TikTok, LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook with strategy, design, copy and reports; from S/1,500.
- [UGC video](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/ugc): creator videos with scripts, filming, editing and test variants for Meta, TikTok and YouTube, usage rights included.
- [Influencer marketing](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/influencer-marketing): creators chosen by real audience, contracts, usage rights and link-based attribution of sales.
- [Public relations](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/relaciones-publicas): press strategy, newsworthy angles, media relations and spokespeople; earned coverage, not paid articles.
- [Email marketing and automation](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/email-marketing): automated flows, newsletters and CRM, including abandoned-cart recovery and repeat purchases.
- [Google Ads for clinics](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/marketing-clinicas): campaigns for clinics and medical practices with appointments via WhatsApp measured and health ad policies respected.
- [Google Ads for dental clinics](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/marketing-clinicas-dentales): implants, orthodontics and emergencies with measured appointments; from S/1,800 per month + IGV.
- [Google Ads for aesthetic clinics](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/marketing-clinicas-esteticas): treatments searched by name, ads within health policies and measured consultations.
- [Google Ads for veterinary clinics](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/marketing-veterinarias): emergencies, vaccines and grooming advertised by district, with calls and WhatsApp measured.
- [Google Ads for law firms](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/marketing-abogados): inquiries by practice area (labor, family, criminal) with calls and WhatsApp measured.
- [Google Ads for real estate](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/marketing-inmobiliarias): searches by district, one landing page per project and leads measured up to the site visit.
- [Google Ads for e-commerce](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/marketing-ecommerce): Shopping, Performance Max and Search optimized for ROAS on Shopify, WooCommerce or VTEX.
- [Digital marketing agency in Lima](https://3rcore.com/es/agencia-marketing-digital-lima): who the agency is: office in La Molina, published prices, no lock-in contract, and the client owns the work from day one.
- [Restaurant websites in Lima](https://3rcore.com/es/diseno-web-restaurantes-lima): digital menu, WhatsApp reservations and online orders with Yape or Plin; from S/1,800.
- [SEO agency for Arequipa](https://3rcore.com/es/agencia-seo-arequipa): SEO for Arequipa businesses served remotely from Lima, with website, Google Business Profile and reporting in the client's Search Console; from S/1,800 per month.
- [Digital marketing for Miraflores businesses](https://3rcore.com/es/agencia-marketing-digital-miraflores): Google Ads, SEO, websites and social media for businesses in Miraflores, served from La Molina.
- [All services](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios) · [Pricing](https://3rcore.com/es/precios): branding from S/500, SEO S/1,800 per month, Google Ads management from S/1,800 per month and websites from S/1,800, net + 18% IGV.
